entries.title: Jeremiah 43:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Johanan, discrediting Jeremiah's prophecy, carries him and the rest into Egypt. 8 Jeremiah prophesies by a type the conquest of Egypt by the Babylonians.
